# shadcn-heatmap

> Four heatmap components for React — calendar, weekday, date, and status. Built on SVG and Tailwind v4 tokens, following shadcn/ui conventions. Install via the shadcn CLI or copy the source and own it entirely.

shadcn-heatmap is a component registry, not an npm package. Each component is a single self-contained `.tsx` file installed into your project with `npx shadcn@latest add rutopio/shadcn-heatmap/<name>`. Runtime dependencies are `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, and (for date-based components) `date-fns`. Tooltips are optional and use your own shadcn `tooltip` component.

## Components

- [CalendarHeatmap](https://heatmap.chingru.com/calendar): GitHub-style yearly contribution grid. Supports multiple years, ISO Monday start, custom colors, i18n labels, and full tooltip control. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add rutopio/shadcn-heatmap/calendar-heatmap`
- [WeekdayHeatmap](https://heatmap.chingru.com/weekday): Weekday × hour-of-day matrix with Sum row/column and independent colour scales. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add rutopio/shadcn-heatmap/weekday-heatmap`
- [DateHeatmap](https://heatmap.chingru.com/date): Date × hour matrix for zooming into a narrow time window with a daily Sum column. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add rutopio/shadcn-heatmap/date-heatmap`
- [StatusHeatmap](https://heatmap.chingru.com/status): Timeline status indicator showing daily activity over a period (e.g. 90 days), similar to Atlassian Statuspage. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add rutopio/shadcn-heatmap/status-heatmap`
- [Binary heatmaps](https://heatmap.chingru.com/binary): Using any of the above with strictly 0/1 values for done/missed, pass/fail, on/off patterns.

## Docs

- [Install](https://heatmap.chingru.com/install): CLI and manual installation, runtime dependencies, and required theme tokens (`--color-chart-1`, `--color-secondary`, `--color-muted-foreground`).
- [Registry (JSON)](https://heatmap.chingru.com/r): shadcn registry items consumed by the CLI.

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/rutopio/shadcn-heatmap): Source code, issues, and MIT license.
